OWNED FILES: frontend/e2e/judge-journeys.js, frontend/e2e/judge-journeys.test.js, frontend/e2e/roleplay-judge.js, frontend/e2e/roleplay-judge.test.js, frontend/e2e/scene-runtime.spec.js (only the @llm-canon test and its helpers), and you may DELETE frontend/e2e/authored-delivery.js and frontend/e2e/authored-delivery.test.js once nothing imports them. Do not edit authored-spans.js or attribution-audit.js (already written; read them first).

BACKGROUND (an external review of our judge work, plus verified facts): The scene canon judge (roleplay-judge.js judgeSceneNarration) sometimes charges authored runtime text as narrator disclosure. Whole-turn markers (`authored_delivery`, from authored-delivery.js) say a turn CONTAINS authored text, not WHICH text, so they can excuse unrelated narrator leaks on the same turn; they also missed turns (the 3B departure sentence 'began the broadcast' is the `t_3b_3c` bridge_text in plot.md, not a reveal delivery). frontend/e2e/authored-spans.js now provides span-level attribution: loadAuthoredText(), eligibleAuthoredTexts(bundle, authored), attributeNarration(narration, eligible) -> spans {text, origin:'authored'|'narrator', source}, knowledgeAvailableByTurn([{turn, bundle}]) -> [{turn, available:[ids]}]. An audit over 239 saved turns found zero reconstruction failures. Also verified: (1) the hosted test's recordRevealedKnowledge(scene, segments) in scene-runtime.spec.js still builds the earned-knowledge set from segment `grounding_ids`, while judge-journeys.js already uses committed bundles; (2) judge-journeys.js unions knowledge over the whole scene, so a fact earned late in a scene can excuse an earlier turn's disclosure; (3) the hosted progress artifact discards segments and bundles; (4) the hosted loop can end after 3C's prompts are exhausted without recording whether the story actually completed.

CHANGES:
A. judge-journeys.js: using the same bundle join it already has, for each usable judge turn add (i) `authored_spans`: only the spans with origin 'authored', each {text, source_kind, source_id}, omitted (no key) when there are none or when the turn has no committed bundle; (ii) `knowledge_available`: the ids from knowledgeAvailableByTurn up to and including that turn (omitted when no bundles exist at all in the scene). REMOVE the old `authored_delivery` marker from judge turns (and its authoredDeliveryReasons import). Keep `narration` as the full unmodified turn text, and keep scene-level `revealedKnowledgeIds` and `reveal_evidence` exactly as they are. Load authored text once per buildSceneJudgments call (or lazily once per process); loadAuthoredText must not run when no bundle exists anywhere (so legacy reports and the existing tests still work without file access beyond what already happens).
B. roleplay-judge.js judgeSceneNarration system prompt: remove the four sentences added for `authored_delivery` markers (the ones starting 'A turn carrying authored_delivery ...' through the one about still judging narrator-written text; find them by reading the file) and replace them with exactly this block, verbatim, in one string segment: "Turns may carry authored_spans and knowledge_available. The supplied authored_spans identify text inserted by the runtime. Exempt only those spans from narrator-disclosure penalties. Judge all other text normally. Use knowledge available on that turn. Read the full turn when judging exit motivation and other quality checks." Do not change CANON_SCHEMA, the seven checks, scoring or any other guidance. Update roleplay-judge.test.js: assert the new block is in the system message, the old marker sentences are gone, and the schema is unchanged.
C. scene-runtime.spec.js (@llm-canon test only; leave the @spine test alone): (1) replace the use of authoredDeliveryReasons: for each turn compute the committed-bundle eligible authored texts from payload.attempt_bundle with loadAuthoredText/eligibleAuthoredTexts, attribute the joined departure narration (the same text pushed as `narration`) with attributeNarration, and push `authored_spans` (authored spans only, same shape as A) on the judge turn when non-empty; (2) push `knowledge_available` per turn computed incrementally from committed bundles seen so far in the scene (temporal: up to and including the turn); (3) make recordRevealedKnowledge prefer the committed bundle's selected_reveal.knowledge_ids when payload.attempt_bundle exists (outcome 'committed'), falling back to segment grounding_ids only when no bundle was exposed, and count turns that used the fallback in the evidence as `reveal_evidence_fallback_turns`; (4) preserve evidence: on each pushed turn also store `segments` (array of {kind, text, grounding_ids}) for the turn's departure segments and a compact `bundle` summary {outcome, transition_cause, story_complete, selected_reveal, cue_stage, committed_delta} (NOT the stages/requests, which are large) when a bundle exists; (5) record completion: track `story_complete_seen` (true if any payload.state?.story_complete or bundle.story_complete was true) and add `story_complete_seen`, `authored_span_turns` (turns with at least one authored span), `bundles_seen` and `reveal_evidence_fallback_turns` as extra top-level keys in both writeCategoryReport calls' evidence objects, replacing `authored_delivery_turns`. Do not add any new assertion that could abort a run; this is evidence only. Keep every existing assertion and loop behavior unchanged.
D. Tests: judge-journeys.test.js: authored_spans present only for authored spans and with source info; absent without bundles; knowledge_available is temporal (a later reveal does not appear on an earlier turn); the marker key is gone; existing behaviors (committed ids, rejected turns, reveal_evidence marker, join by scene.bundles) still pass. Use small synthetic reports and a stubbed/real authored text as convenient (the real package via loadAuthoredText is fine and offline); include one test that builds a judge input for a synthetic 3B departure turn whose text contains the real 3B->3C bridge sentence plus a narrator-written sentence and asserts only the bridge sentence is in authored_spans.

Match surrounding style. Notes (what you changed, anything you chose not to do) to /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/stage2-notes/spans-wiring-notes.md.
